race.description: Nathan Costello Wtc Thanks You For 14 Yrs Mdn Plate
race.comment: LUMINOUS GIRL (8) has been kept fresh since finishing sixth over 800m at Ipswich. Kept up to the mark with a recent Deagon trial win. Rates well on best form and a bold showing is expected. VIDEO VIXEN (10) comes here off a break of nine weeks. Worth noting she filled a minor placing when returning from a spell last time in work over 1200m at Gold Coast. Has switched to the Kristie Clark-Peoples yard. Has found the right race and is worth including. SALUKI (11) was beaten just a long neck last start and landed her first top-three finish in the process at Dingo over 900m. Makes plenty of appeal on the back of that latest effort.  GENERAL DANCER (6) resumes from a spell of 16 months and is having her first outing under new trainer Michael Murphy. Finished tenth at Ipswich over 1240m at the opening run last time in work. Will be forward for this after a recent trial win at Deagon and a bold showing is expected.
